cat > rosterkit/notices.py <<'EOF'
# owner: platform
"""Parent-facing absence notices."""

from typing import Iterable

from rosterkit.attendance import days_missed
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError
from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student


def absence_notice(student: Student, marks: Iterable[Mark]) -> str:
    """Short text notice listing the days the student was absent."""
    marks = list(marks)
    if any(mark.student_id != student.student_id for mark in marks):
        raise ProjectError("marks belong to a different student")
    days = days_missed(marks)
    if not days:
        raise ProjectError("no absences to report")
    dates = ", ".join(day.isoformat() for day in days)
    return f"{student.first_name} {student.last_name} missed {len(days)} day(s): {dates}."
EOF
cat > tests/test_notices.py <<'EOF'
# owner: platform
import unittest
from datetime import date

from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError
from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student
from rosterkit.notices import absence_notice

ANA = Student("s1", "Diaz", "Ana", "A")


class NoticeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_lists_dates_in_order(self):
        marks = [
            Mark("s1", date(2026, 9, 4), "absent"),
            Mark("s1", date(2026, 9, 2), "absent"),
            Mark("s1", date(2026, 9, 3), "excused"),
        ]
        text = absence_notice(ANA, marks)
        self.assertEqual(text, "Ana Diaz missed 2 day(s): 2026-09-02, 2026-09-04.")

    def test_other_student_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            absence_notice(ANA, [Mark("s2", date(2026, 9, 2), "absent")])

    def test_no_absences_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            absence_notice(ANA, [Mark("s1", date(2026, 9, 2), "present")])
EOF

commits.message:
Add parent absence notices

Parents need a short written notice of the days their child missed. The new function builds it from a student and their marks, and refuses mismatched marks or an empty absence list.
